name: Hermey
subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
description: Native client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent. Every bot (Hermes profile) is reachable through one gateway; approvals, streaming replies and tool output appear in the conversation. Builds are unsigned and must be re-signed by your sideloading app.

apps.name: Hermey
apps.subtitle: Your Hermes bots, on your phone
apps.localizedDescription: Chats with every Hermes bot, streaming replies, tool cards, inline approvals and per-device pairing.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Fixed
- **The Dynamic Island fits its words.** A running timer with no natural width was shared by the island
  and the lock-screen card, so the island grew to most of the screen with a name at one end, and the card's
  text was squeezed away until the turn finished. The island is now just the bot's mark, its name and the
  elapsed time at their own sizes.
- **The card stays until you remove it.** It used to end itself a few seconds after the reply. It now stays
  in the island and on the lock screen — swipe it away when you are done with it.
- **Glass, not a yellow panel.** The card no longer paints a tint of its own; the lock screen's material
  shows through, with the bot's accent kept to the mark and the status line, which is now always visible —
  including during the first seconds of a turn.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan the pairing code shown by your Hermes host to connect this device.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Hermes connects to your own Hermes host over your private network.
